description: Generated by scripts/refresh_playbooks.py from MITRE's official Enterprise ATT&CK STIX release. Mitigation text is MITRE's own.

steps.text: User Training involves educating employees and contractors on recognizing, reporting, and preventing cyber threats that rely on human interaction, such as phishing, social engineering, and other manipulative techniques. Comprehensive training programs create a human firewall by empowering users to be an active component of the organization's cybersecurity defenses.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1017 — mitigates T1036 Masquerading; T1078 Valid Accounts; T1111 Multi-Factor Authentication Interception; …

steps.text: User Account Management involves implementing and enforcing policies for the lifecycle of user accounts, including creation, modification, and deactivation. Proper account management reduces the attack surface by limiting unauthorized access, managing account privileges, and ensuring accounts are used according to organizational policies.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1018 — mitigates T1036 Masquerading; T1078 Valid Accounts; T1098 Account Manipulation; …

steps.text: Restricting web-based content involves enforcing policies and technologies that limit access to potentially malicious websites, unsafe downloads, and unauthorized browser behaviors. This can include URL filtering, download restrictions, script blocking, and extension control to protect against exploitation, phishing, and malware delivery.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1021 — mitigates T1539 Steal Web Session Cookie; T1566 Phishing; T1566.001 Spearphishing Attachment; …

steps.text: Set and enforce secure password policies for accounts to reduce the likelihood of unauthorized access. Strong password policies include enforcing password complexity, requiring regular password changes, and preventing password reuse.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1027 — mitigates T1078 Valid Accounts; T1550 Use Alternate Authentication Material

steps.text: Use intrusion detection signatures to block traffic at network boundaries.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1031 — mitigates T1219 Remote Access Tools; T1566 Phishing; T1566.001 Spearphishing Attachment

steps.text: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enhances security by requiring users to provide at least two forms of verification to prove their identity before granting access. These factors typically include: - *Something you know*: Passwords, PINs.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1032 — mitigates T1078 Valid Accounts; T1098 Account Manipulation; T1098.005 Device Registration; …

steps.text: Account Use Policies help mitigate unauthorized access by configuring and enforcing rules that govern how and when accounts can be used. These policies include enforcing account lockout mechanisms, restricting login times, and setting inactivity timeouts.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1036 — mitigates T1078 Valid Accounts; T1550 Use Alternate Authentication Material; T1621 Multi-Factor Authentication Request Generation

steps.text: Prevent the execution of unauthorized or malicious code on systems by implementing application control, script blocking, and other execution prevention mechanisms. This ensures that only trusted and authorized code is executed, reducing the risk of malware and unauthorized actions.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1038 — mitigates T1036 Masquerading; T1204.002 Malicious File; T1219 Remote Access Tools

steps.text: Behavior Prevention on Endpoint refers to the use of technologies and strategies to detect and block potentially malicious activities by analyzing the behavior of processes, files, API calls, and other endpoint events. Rather than relying solely on known signatures, this approach leverages heuristics, machine learning, and real-time monitoring to identify anomalous patterns indicative of an attack.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1040 — mitigates T1036 Masquerading; T1204.002 Malicious File

steps.text: Disable or remove unnecessary and potentially vulnerable software, features, or services to reduce the attack surface and prevent abuse by adversaries. This involves identifying software or features that are no longer needed or that could be exploited and ensuring they are either removed or properly disabled.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1042 — mitigates T1098 Account Manipulation; T1219 Remote Access Tools

steps.text: Code Signing is a security process that ensures the authenticity and integrity of software by digitally signing executables, scripts, and other code artifacts. It prevents untrusted or malicious code from executing by verifying the digital signatures against trusted sources.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1045 — mitigates T1036 Masquerading

steps.text: Auditing is the process of recording activity and systematically reviewing and analyzing the activity and system configurations. The primary purpose of auditing is to detect anomalies and identify potential threats or weaknesses in the environment.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1047 — mitigates T1036 Masquerading; T1539 Steal Web Session Cookie; T1550 Use Alternate Authentication Material; …

steps.text: Antivirus/Antimalware solutions utilize signatures, heuristics, and behavioral analysis to detect, block, and remediate malicious software, including viruses, trojans, ransomware, and spyware. These solutions continuously monitor endpoints and systems for known malicious patterns and suspicious behaviors that indicate compromise.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1049 — mitigates T1036 Masquerading; T1566 Phishing; T1566.001 Spearphishing Attachment; …

steps.text: Software updates ensure systems are protected against known vulnerabilities by applying patches and upgrades provided by vendors. Regular updates reduce the attack surface and prevent adversaries from exploiting known security gaps.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1051 — mitigates T1539 Steal Web Session Cookie

steps.text: Software configuration refers to making security-focused adjustments to the settings of applications, middleware, databases, or other software to mitigate potential threats. These changes help reduce the attack surface, enforce best practices, and protect sensitive data.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1054 — mitigates T1539 Steal Web Session Cookie; T1566 Phishing; T1566.001 Spearphishing Attachment; …

steps.text: Pre-compromise mitigations involve proactive measures and defenses implemented to prevent adversaries from successfully identifying and exploiting weaknesses during the Reconnaissance and Resource Development phases of an attack. These activities focus on reducing an organization's attack surface, identify adversarial preparation efforts, and increase the difficulty for attackers to conduct successful operations.
steps.source: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise mitigation M1056 — mitigates T1583.001 Domains; T1585 Establish Accounts; T1585.001 Social Media Accounts; …
